title: Add gamepad flashlight toggle
objective: Add support in the existing flashlight example so a gamepad button can toggle the flashlight on and off.
instructions: Locate the flashlight example that was recently built.
Add gamepad button handling to toggle the flashlight on/off, using existing input patterns in the repo where possible.
Prefer a lean, narrowly scoped implementation; do not redesign the example or broader input system unless necessary.
Choose a sensible default gamepad button and document it in the ResultPacket; if existing conventions indicate a specific button, follow them.
Avoid adding Inspector/QA workflow; include manual verification steps for the user to run in the simulator.
constraints: Keep changes limited to product code/tests directly needed for the flashlight example.
expected_outputs: Summary of behavior and selected gamepad button.
definition_of_done: The flashlight example can toggle the flashlight on/off from a keyboard/mouse path that already existed, and from a gamepad button.
No unrelated refactors or docs churn.
